dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge exhibiting a smooth parabolic curvature from the mid-section to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex classification with a wide pixel radius at the terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with an approximate 45-degree inclination relative to the primary longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Wide-based geometry where the maximum horizontal pixel width exceeds the vertical pixel height by a factor of approximately 1.4.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Distinctly convex melon profile with a large radius arc extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio as measured from the cranial inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle forming a visible crease at the junction of the melon and the dorsal rostrum surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped notch/lesion on the mid-trailing edge of the dorsal fin; several circular depigmented marks present on the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlights on the dorsal-lateral surface due to high-intensity directional lighting.
